name: @weir/cre-keeper
description: A Chainlink CRE workflow that reads MandateHub on a cron and charges the due mandates through MandateCharger by signed report

scripts.simulate: sh -c 'cre workflow simulate weir-charger --target staging-settings --env ../../.env --non-interactive --trigger-index 0 "$@"; status=$?; rm -f weir-charger/.cre_build_tmp.js; exit $status' --
